Kitchen Organization

3 Small Kitchen Upgrades That Instantly Create More Space

By Sarah Mitchell · 3 min read · Updated August 8, 2026

Living in a small apartment doesn't mean you have to settle for cramped counters and cluttered cabinets. A few simple organization upgrades can make a small kitchen feel bigger, calmer, and infinitely more functional.

By taking advantage of vertical height, establishing clear functional zones, and reclaiming hidden under-sink space, you can double your usable kitchen storage overnight without drilling single hole in your rental walls.

1. Maximize Vertical Storage & Door Space

In compact kitchens, vertical air space is your greatest asset. Instead of letting empty space sit above spices or inside cabinet doors, install slim vertical sliding racks or magnetic side-fridge organizers to keep everyday cooking essentials visible and accessible.

Pull-Out Spice Rack for Narrow Cabinets

Problem: Narrow upper cabinets next to the stove often turn into dark, unorganized gaps where spice jars get pushed to the back and forgotten.
Solution: This dual-tier sliding rack mounts inside slim 4" to 6" cabinets, utilizing smooth ball-bearing glides to pull all 20+ spice jars directly forward into full view.

  • Navigates narrow 4" to 6" cabinet gaps effortlessly
  • Smooth ball-bearing glide tracks pull out completely
  • Holds up to 20 standard spice bottles securely

2. Create Organized Zones in Drawers

Unorganized drawers naturally become junk drawers where cutlery, whisks, and measuring spoons get tangled together. Using expandable bamboo drawer dividers creates designated zones for every utensil, ensuring smooth cooking and rapid cleanup.

Expandable Bamboo Drawer Organizer

Problem: Standard plastic cutlery trays leave wasted gaps along drawer edges, causing spatulas, serving spoons, and whisks to jam the drawer when closing.
Solution: Designed with expandable side wings, this bamboo tray adjusts from 13" to 20" wide to create tailored compartments that keep utensils flat and organized.

  • Expands from 13" to 20" to fit custom drawer widths
  • Deep dividers prevent cutlery from mixing
  • Water-resistant natural bamboo finish

3. Unlock Hidden Under-Sink Space

The space beneath the kitchen sink is notoriously tricky due to plumbing pipes and garbage disposals. Installing a 2-tier sliding under-sink shelf with removable cutouts turns chaotic cleaning supplies into an organized, easy-to-reach system.

2-Tier Under Sink Sliding Organizer

Problem: The dark cabinet under the kitchen sink is constantly blocked by plumbing pipes, disposal units, and disorganized cleaning bottles.
Solution: Built with a slim top tier and a sliding lower drawer, this 2-tier organizer fits around plumbing lines and pulls cleaning bottles out into easy reach.

  • Navigates around plumbing pipes and disposal units
  • Bottom drawer pulls out smoothly for easy access
  • Waterproof corrosion-resistant frame
